# ctrlc 3.5.2 — 2026-09-14

- crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/ctrlc (2026-02-10)
- docs: https://docs.rs/ctrlc/3.5.2/ctrlc/
- license: MIT OR Apache-2.0

```toml
ctrlc = { version = "3.5.2", features = ["termination"] }
```

Default `set_handler` is SIGINT only. Feature `termination` also runs the handler for SIGTERM and SIGHUP. Handler sets a flag and `process::exit(0)` so `follow` exits 0 even during a blocking ureq long-poll (ureq has no cancel). Dedicated signal thread; one handler per process.
